summary: Burlington Stores filed an 8-K reporting that Matthew Pasch, EVP and Chief Human Resources Officer, will depart effective September 1, 2026, with severance benefits under the company's Executive Severance Plan, including pro-rata vesting of a 2024 performance-based RSU. John Pershing is expected to succeed him in October 2026. This is a senior executive transition but not an abrupt or forced departure; it is a routine succession matter with standard severance disclosures. No special-situation transaction, strategic action, or deal is involved. The filing also includes an Other Events item solely for the successor announcement. This is a customary officer transition report; no special-situation classification applies.
